negativeConstraints: Never invent any text, logo, wordmark or mark beyond the ones this record names, never misspell or rearrange those, and never add a second label. Never make the outsole lugs shallow or smooth, and never make the mesh glossy.
preservationNotes: Keep VOSS ROWE printed small in black sans-serif capitals along the outer heel counter and the small orange VR monogram on the tongue. Keep the bone mesh, the burnt-orange overlays over the midfoot and toe cap, the black speed laces with their toggle, the orange heel loop, the sculpted bone midsole and the black deep-lugged outsole in every shot.
